title: Why China's Shein is beating ASOS, H&M and Zara at fast fashion
speaker: CNBC International
zh: 【CNBC International】為什麼中國的Shein能在快時尚領域擊敗ASOS、H&M和Zara（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Fashion has had to constantly evolve.
cues.en: Fashion has had to constantly evolve.
cues.zh: 時尚必須不斷發展。

cues.text: But the industry radically changed in the 1990s when brands like Zara, H&M and Topshop led the way with what we now know as fast fashion.
cues.en: But the industry radically changed in the 1990s when brands like Zara, H&M and Topshop led the way with what we now know as fast fashion.
cues.zh: 但這個產業在 20 世紀 90 年代發生了根本性的變化，Zara、H&M 和 Topshop 等品牌引領了我們現在所說的快時尚的潮流。

cues.text: They mastered the process of taking expensive clothes that were on the catwalk
cues.en: They mastered the process of taking expensive clothes that were on the catwalk
cues.zh: 他們掌握了在T臺上挑選昂貴衣服的過程

cues.text: and mass producing them in as little as three weeks.
cues.en: and mass producing them in as little as three weeks.
cues.zh: 並在短短三週內批次生產它們。

cues.text: Fashion had never been this cheap and accessible before.
cues.en: Fashion had never been this cheap and accessible before.
cues.zh: 時尚從未如此廉價和觸手可及。

cues.text: Then, at the turn of the century online-only giants like Asos and Boohoo
cues.en: Then, at the turn of the century online-only giants like Asos and Boohoo
cues.zh: 然後，在世紀之交出現了像 Asos 和 Boohoo 這樣的純線上巨頭

cues.text: took this model to the next level, shortening production time to as little as a week.
cues.en: took this model to the next level, shortening production time to as little as a week.
cues.zh: 將該模型提升到了一個新的水平，將生產時間縮短至短短一週。

cues.text: Industry experts call these online-only brands, ultra fast fashion.
cues.en: Industry experts call these online-only brands, ultra fast fashion.
cues.zh: 行業專家將這些僅線上品牌稱為“超快時尚”。

cues.text: And now we're in a new era: Real-time retail.
cues.en: And now we're in a new era: Real-time retail.
cues.zh: 現在我們正處於一個新時代：即時零售。

cues.text: Companies disrupting the status quo produce clothes in as little as three days.
cues.en: Companies disrupting the status quo produce clothes in as little as three days.
cues.zh: 打破現狀的公司只需三天就能生產衣服。

cues.text: And this era's leader? Well, it's a Chinese company called Shein.
cues.en: And this era's leader? Well, it's a Chinese company called Shein.
cues.zh: 而這個時代的領導者呢？嗯，這是一家中國公司，名叫Shein。

cues.text: Shein launches around three to four thousand new female apparel products every day so it is
cues.en: Shein launches around three to four thousand new female apparel products every day so it is
cues.zh: Shein 每天推出大約三到四千種新的女性服裝產品，因此

cues.text: a very huge amount and the product is at pretty low price ranging from two dollars USD to $30.
cues.en: a very huge amount and the product is at pretty low price ranging from two dollars USD to $30.
cues.zh: 數量非常大，而且產品價格相當低，從 2 美元到 30 美元不等。

cues.text: It is very fast and the products are updated
cues.en: It is very fast and the products are updated
cues.zh: 速度非常快，產品更新也很快

cues.text: much more frequently and at a higher volume than any other fast fashion brand.
cues.en: much more frequently and at a higher volume than any other fast fashion brand.
cues.zh: 比任何其他快時尚品牌的頻率和數量都要高得多。

cues.text: In April 2022, it was reported that fashion the startup was worth $100 billion,
cues.en: In April 2022, it was reported that fashion the startup was worth $100 billion,
cues.zh: 2022 年 4 月，據報道時尚這家新創公司價值 1000 億美元，

cues.text: which would make it more valuable than H&M and Zara combined.
cues.en: which would make it more valuable than H&M and Zara combined.
cues.zh: 這將使其價值超過 H&M 和 Zara 的總和。

cues.text: Guys I placed a $500 Shein order and it came in the mail.
cues.en: Guys I placed a $500 Shein order and it came in the mail.
cues.zh: 夥計們，我下了一張 500 美元的 Shein 訂單，它已經郵寄過來了。

cues.text: Y'all! The Shein package that I was waiting for arrived, so let's open it.
cues.en: Y'all! The Shein package that I was waiting for arrived, so let's open it.
cues.zh: 你們大家！我等待的 Shein 包裹到了，我們開啟它吧。

cues.text: So let's dig, how did Shein beat these fast fashion outlets at their own game?
cues.en: So let's dig, how did Shein beat these fast fashion outlets at their own game?
cues.zh: 那麼讓我們來探討一下，Shein 是如何在這些快時尚品牌的遊戲中擊敗他們的呢？

cues.text: Shein is a very secretive company and shares little publicly about its origins
cues.en: Shein is a very secretive company and shares little publicly about its origins
cues.zh: Shein 是一家非常神秘的公司，很少公開透露其起源

cues.text: and, as I learned through my reporting, it was pretty much impossible to connect with a spokesperson for the company.
cues.en: and, as I learned through my reporting, it was pretty much impossible to connect with a spokesperson for the company.
cues.zh: 而且，正如我透過報道瞭解到的那樣，幾乎不可能聯絡到該公司的發言人。

cues.text: We did find two consultants who had studied the company closely for years. Here's what we learned.
cues.en: We did find two consultants who had studied the company closely for years. Here's what we learned.
cues.zh: 我們確實找到了兩位對這家公司進行了多年密切研究的顧問。這是我們學到的。

cues.text: The CEO and founder has only been seen a couple times and yeah he really it really keeps an air of mystery.
cues.en: The CEO and founder has only been seen a couple times and yeah he really it really keeps an air of mystery.
cues.zh: 這位執行長兼創辦人只見過幾次面，是的，他確實保持著一種神秘的氣氛。

cues.text: This mysterious CEO is Chris Xu, a former digital marketer experienced in search engine optimization or SEO.
cues.en: This mysterious CEO is Chris Xu, a former digital marketer experienced in search engine optimization or SEO.
cues.zh: 這位神秘的執行長是 Chris Xu，他是一位在搜尋引擎最佳化或 SEO 方面經驗豐富的前數位行銷人員。

cues.text: Even though Shein states it was founded in 2012, several sources say its origin story actually began in 2008 in Eastern China.
cues.en: Even though Shein states it was founded in 2012, several sources say its origin story actually began in 2008 in Eastern China.
cues.zh: 儘管 Shein 聲稱其成立於 2012 年，但多位訊息人士稱，其起源故事實際上始於 2008 年的中國東部。

cues.text: That's when Xu and his business partners founded Dianwei, an e-commerce business that reportedly sold everything from knockoff goods to wedding dresses.
cues.en: That's when Xu and his business partners founded Dianwei, an e-commerce business that reportedly sold everything from knockoff goods to wedding dresses.
cues.zh: 就在那時，徐和他的商業夥伴創立了電商公司，據報道，該公司銷售從山寨貨到婚紗等各種商品。

cues.text: It was here that Xu seemingly refined the business model that would eventually launch Shein to success.
cues.en: It was here that Xu seemingly refined the business model that would eventually launch Shein to success.
cues.zh: 正是在這裡，徐似乎改進了商業模式，最終使 Shein 取得了成功。

cues.text: In 2011, Xu and his partners parted ways, and the domain that would become Shein was registered.
cues.en: In 2011, Xu and his partners parted ways, and the domain that would become Shein was registered.
cues.zh: 2011年，徐和他的合夥人分道揚鑣，註冊了後來成為Shein的網域。

cues.text: Investment began to pour in and so did sales.
cues.en: Investment began to pour in and so did sales.
cues.zh: 投資開始湧入，銷售也開始湧入。

cues.text: At the same time, the world was being transformed by a five-ounce device: the iPhone.
cues.en: At the same time, the world was being transformed by a five-ounce device: the iPhone.
cues.zh: 同時，世界正被一款 5 盎司重的裝置所改變：iPhone。

cues.text: Apple's rivals are rushing their own versions of this kind of product out into the stores.
cues.en: Apple's rivals are rushing their own versions of this kind of product out into the stores.
cues.zh: 蘋果的競爭對手正在將自己的此類產品推向商店。

cues.text: And China's growing middle class played a huge role in the smartphone revolution that followed.
cues.en: And China's growing middle class played a huge role in the smartphone revolution that followed.
cues.zh: 中國不斷壯大的中產階級在隨後的智慧型手機革命中發揮了巨大作用。

cues.text: All of a sudden everybody is getting smartphones and so the majority of Chinese kind of skipped
cues.en: All of a sudden everybody is getting smartphones and so the majority of Chinese kind of skipped
cues.zh: 突然間每個人都有智慧型手機，所以大多數中國人都跳過了

cues.text: the computer phase and the introduction to the digital world was really through the smartphone.
cues.en: the computer phase and the introduction to the digital world was really through the smartphone.
cues.zh: 電腦階段和數位世界的引入實際上是透過智慧型手機實現的。

cues.text: Between 2009 and 2012 the number of smartphones shipped to China grew
cues.en: Between 2009 and 2012 the number of smartphones shipped to China grew
cues.zh: 2009年至2012年間，運往中國的智慧型手機數量有所增加

cues.text: from 13 million to nearly 200 million, a more than 1400% rise.
cues.en: from 13 million to nearly 200 million, a more than 1400% rise.
cues.zh: 從1300萬增加到近2億，成長超過1400%。

cues.text: China overtook the U.S. to become the world's largest smartphone market.
cues.en: China overtook the U.S. to become the world's largest smartphone market.
cues.zh: 中國超越美國成為全球最大的智慧型手機市場。

cues.text: This phenomenon fueled the rise of e-commerce platforms in the country such
cues.en: This phenomenon fueled the rise of e-commerce platforms in the country such
cues.zh: 這一現象推動了該國電子商務平臺的崛起，例如

cues.text: as Alibaba, JD.com and of course Shein.
cues.en: as Alibaba, JD.com and of course Shein.

cues.text: But unlike most of china's e-commerce giants Shein wasn't interested in Chinese customers.
cues.en: But unlike most of china's e-commerce giants Shein wasn't interested in Chinese customers.
cues.zh: 但與大多數中國電子商務巨頭不同的是，Shein 對中國客戶不感興趣。

cues.text: Shein's focus is entirely on the outside world.
cues.en: Shein's focus is entirely on the outside world.
cues.zh: Shein 的注意力完全集中在外在世界。

cues.text: However, a lot of the marketing tactics that Shein uses are inspired by and very similar to
cues.en: However, a lot of the marketing tactics that Shein uses are inspired by and very similar to
cues.zh: 然而，Shein 使用的許多行銷策略都受到以下啟發並且非常相似：

cues.text: to Chinese fashion brands that are operating in the country and also Chinese e-commerce sites
cues.en: to Chinese fashion brands that are operating in the country and also Chinese e-commerce sites

cues.text: that are operating in the country.
cues.en: that are operating in the country.
cues.zh: 在該國運營的。

cues.text: And so, if Shein were to target just the Chinese audience, it is actually a much more saturated market
cues.en: And so, if Shein were to target just the Chinese audience, it is actually a much more saturated market
cues.zh: 因此，如果 Shein 只針對中國觀眾，那麼它實際上是一個更飽和的市場

cues.text: and wouldn't be able to compete in terms of speed and price like how it does compete in the West.
cues.en: and wouldn't be able to compete in terms of speed and price like how it does compete in the West.
cues.zh: 並且無法像在西方那樣在速度和價格方面進行競爭。

cues.text: Shein's Chinese roots gave it another advantage too: a rich understanding of data and how to use it.
cues.en: Shein's Chinese roots gave it another advantage too: a rich understanding of data and how to use it.
cues.zh: Shein 的中國血統也賦予了它另一個優勢：對資料及其使用方法的豐富理解。

cues.text: As a mobile-first country with lax privacy laws and the largest population in the world,
cues.en: As a mobile-first country with lax privacy laws and the largest population in the world,
cues.zh: 作為一個隱私法寬鬆且人口數量全球最多的行動優先國家，

cues.text: collecting user information was easy.
cues.en: collecting user information was easy.
cues.zh: 收集使用者資訊很容易。

cues.text: This created the perfect foundation for developing rigorous algorithms.
cues.en: This created the perfect foundation for developing rigorous algorithms.
cues.zh: 這為開發嚴格的演演算法奠定了完美的基礎。

cues.text: By 2015, Sheinside had rebranded to Shein.
cues.en: By 2015, Sheinside had rebranded to Shein.
cues.zh: 2015 年，Sheinside 更名為 Shein。

cues.text: It had collected an enormous amount of data through its shopping app and had developed a system to score websites like Etsy, Instagram and Google for fashion trends.
cues.en: It had collected an enormous amount of data through its shopping app and had developed a system to score websites like Etsy, Instagram and Google for fashion trends.
cues.zh: 該公司透過其購物應用程式收集了大量資料，並開發了一個系統，可以對 Etsy、Instagram 和 Google 等網站的時尚趨勢進行評分。

cues.text: At this stage I think Shein definitely has the first-move advantage by its big data analytics system,
cues.en: At this stage I think Shein definitely has the first-move advantage by its big data analytics system,
cues.zh: 現階段我認為Shein憑藉其大資料分析系統絕對具有先發優勢，

cues.text: which enables pretty early identification of some trends emerging from online
cues.en: which enables pretty early identification of some trends emerging from online
cues.zh: 這使得能夠儘早識別線上出現的一些趨勢

cues.text: so I think that's one of the critical key success factors of Shein and also will keep it ahead of the competition.
cues.en: so I think that's one of the critical key success factors of Shein and also will keep it ahead of the competition.
cues.zh: 所以我認為這是 Shein 成功的關鍵因素之一，也將使其在競爭中保持領先。

cues.text: In the same year, Shein shifted its supply chain operations center to the Panyu district in Guangzhou,
cues.en: In the same year, Shein shifted its supply chain operations center to the Panyu district in Guangzhou,
cues.zh: 同年，Shein將供應鏈營運中心轉移至廣州番禺區，

cues.text: a major clothing manufacturing hub.
cues.en: a major clothing manufacturing hub.
cues.zh: 主要服裝製造中心。

cues.text: Their office in Guangzhou is in close proximity to their factories and so it really sped up the communication.
cues.en: Their office in Guangzhou is in close proximity to their factories and so it really sped up the communication.
cues.zh: 他們在廣州的辦公室離他們的工廠很近，所以這確實加快了溝通速度。

cues.text: Over time the company's reputation for making timely payments to suppliers,
cues.en: Over time the company's reputation for making timely payments to suppliers,
cues.zh: 隨著時間的推移，公司因及時向供應商付款而享有盛譽，

cues.text: a rarity in the industry, meant factories that would normally accept orders of a minimum quantity
cues.en: a rarity in the industry, meant factories that would normally accept orders of a minimum quantity
cues.zh: 這在行業中是罕見的，這意味著工廠通常會接受最低數量的訂單

cues.text: were eager to take on Shein's orders.
cues.en: were eager to take on Shein's orders.
cues.zh: 急於接受謝因的命令。

cues.text: And avoiding these minimum orders helped Shein develop another competitive advantage: the lean model.
cues.en: And avoiding these minimum orders helped Shein develop another competitive advantage: the lean model.
cues.zh: 避免這些最低訂單幫助 Shein 開發了另一個競爭優勢：精益模型。

cues.text: We call it small order, quick response.
cues.en: We call it small order, quick response.
cues.zh: 我們稱之為小訂單、快速回應。

cues.text: So basically that means Shein places orders in a smaller batch and then it is able to quickly
cues.en: So basically that means Shein places orders in a smaller batch and then it is able to quickly
cues.zh: 所以基本上這意味著 Shein 以較小的批次下訂單，然後能夠快速

cues.text: adjust it based on the market performance.
cues.en: adjust it based on the market performance.
cues.zh: 根據市場表現進行調整。

cues.text: The suppliers will just produce 100-500 items as the first batch which will take around only three to five days to produce.
cues.en: The suppliers will just produce 100-500 items as the first batch which will take around only three to five days to produce.
cues.zh: 第一批供應商將只生產 100-500 件產品，生產時間大約只需三到五天。

cues.text: Where, if we compare that with the traditional fast fashion players like Zara,
cues.en: Where, if we compare that with the traditional fast fashion players like Zara,
cues.zh: 如果我們將其與 Zara 等傳統快時尚企業進行比較，

cues.text: usually it will produce over 100, 000 items so, by placing small orders, Shein could react pretty rapidly based on the sales performance.
cues.en: usually it will produce over 100, 000 items so, by placing small orders, Shein could react pretty rapidly based on the sales performance.
cues.zh: 通常它會生產超過 100, 000 件商品，因此，透過下小訂單，Shein 可以根據銷售業績做出快速反應。

cues.text: These products are then shipped directly to consumers from China.
cues.en: These products are then shipped directly to consumers from China.
cues.zh: 然後這些產品直接從中國運往消費者手中。

cues.text: This cuts out middlemen and expensive import tariffs.
cues.en: This cuts out middlemen and expensive import tariffs.
cues.zh: 這消除了中間商和昂貴的進口關稅。

cues.text: Competitors making larger bulk shipments to stores aren't so lucky.
cues.en: Competitors making larger bulk shipments to stores aren't so lucky.
cues.zh: 向商店大批次發貨的競爭對手就沒那麼幸運了。

cues.text: While the pandemic was devastating for most of the clothing industry, it was good for Shein.
cues.en: While the pandemic was devastating for most of the clothing industry, it was good for Shein.
cues.zh: 雖然這場流行病對大多數服裝業來說是毀滅性的，但對 Shein 來說卻是件好事。

cues.text: Its sales generated an estimated 9.8 billion dollars in 2020,
cues.en: Its sales generated an estimated 9.8 billion dollars in 2020,
cues.zh: 2020 年其銷售額估計為 98 億美元，

cues.text: and 15.7 billion dollars in 2021 and Shein was shipping to most countries in the world.
cues.en: and 15.7 billion dollars in 2021 and Shein was shipping to most countries in the world.

cues.text: In 2021, it overtook Amazon to become the most downloaded shopping app in the U.S.,
cues.en: In 2021, it overtook Amazon to become the most downloaded shopping app in the U.S.,
cues.zh: 2021年，它超越亞馬遜成為美國下載次數最多的購物應用程式，

cues.text: and these users were spending a lot of time on the app.
cues.en: and these users were spending a lot of time on the app.

cues.text: But it hasn't been all smooth sailing.
cues.en: But it hasn't been all smooth sailing.
cues.zh: 但事情並非一帆風順。

cues.text: Even though Covid restrictions were being eased abroad, they only intensified at home and Shein's growth began to slow.
cues.en: Even though Covid restrictions were being eased abroad, they only intensified at home and Shein's growth began to slow.

cues.text: And then there are the controversies.
cues.en: And then there are the controversies.
cues.zh: 然後還有爭議。

cues.text: One of the downsides of using data is that it can sometimes see that: "Oh, a particular blouse is wildly popular on an e-commerce platform,
cues.en: One of the downsides of using data is that it can sometimes see that: "Oh, a particular blouse is wildly popular on an e-commerce platform,
cues.zh: 使用資料的缺點之一是有時可以看到：「哦，特定的襯衫在電子商務平臺上非常受歡迎，

cues.text: what if they just recreate the blouse in a cheaper way?"
cues.en: what if they just recreate the blouse in a cheaper way?"
cues.zh: 如果他們以更便宜的方式重新製作這件襯衫怎麼辦？ 」

cues.text: Several smaller designers have taken to social media alleging that Shein had stolen their designs.
cues.en: Several smaller designers have taken to social media alleging that Shein had stolen their designs.
cues.zh: 幾位較小的設計師在社交媒體上聲稱 Shein 竊取了他們的設計。

cues.text: This top is a knock off of my silk lace cami to the tee. It's exactly the same and they're selling it for $10.
cues.en: This top is a knock off of my silk lace cami to the tee. It's exactly the same and they're selling it for $10.
cues.zh: 這件上衣是我的絲綢蕾絲吊帶衫的仿製品。完全一樣，而且售價 10 美元。

cues.text: This is the original design.
cues.en: This is the original design.
cues.zh: 這是最初的設計。

cues.text: But it is hard for like boutique clothing designers when their designs are copied and somebody can just get it from Shein.
cues.en: But it is hard for like boutique clothing designers when their designs are copied and somebody can just get it from Shein.
cues.zh: 但對於像精品服裝設計師這樣的人來說，當他們的設計被抄襲並且有人可以從 Shein 那裡獲得時，這就很困難了。

cues.text: That wreaks havoc on the industry because what it does is it allows the large companies
cues.en: That wreaks havoc on the industry because what it does is it allows the large companies
cues.zh: 這對整個行業造成了嚴重破壞，因為它的作用是讓大公司

cues.text: to just really rake in all the profits that could have been going to small and local boutiques and designers.
cues.en: to just really rake in all the profits that could have been going to small and local boutiques and designers.
cues.zh: 真正賺取本來可以流向小型本地精品店和設計師的所有利潤。

cues.text: And it's not just the independent designers.
cues.en: And it's not just the independent designers.
cues.zh: 而且不只是獨立設計師。

cues.text: Shein has been sued by Doc Martens and Levi Strauss for copying their products
cues.en: Shein has been sued by Doc Martens and Levi Strauss for copying their products
cues.zh: Shein 因抄襲其產品而被 Doc Martens 和 Levi Strauss 起訴

cues.text: and selling them at a fraction of the price.
cues.en: and selling them at a fraction of the price.
cues.zh: 並以一小部分價格出售。

cues.text: It has been reported that Shein removed from sale some of the allegedly offending designs
cues.en: It has been reported that Shein removed from sale some of the allegedly offending designs
